subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt and maintain this Wear OS companion app after the remaining security, auth, CI, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This is a large new app surface with auth-bearing direct gateway access, phone proxying, and release/support ownership; automation can identify blockers but cannot choose product ownership or long-term maintenance scope.

options.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android owner agrees to carry the rebase, security repairs, CI wiring, and release-quality proof before merge.

options.title: Pause or close as unsponsored
options.body: Close or leave paused if no maintainer will own the new Wear app surface, inviting a fresh smaller proposal when ownership and proof are available.

recommendation.title: Adopt with Android owner sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android owner agrees to carry the rebase, security repairs, CI wiring, and release-quality proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the live assignee and has the strongest recent Android auth/gateway history tied to the risky parts of this PR.
